verdict.rationale: kitty is a locally installed terminal emulator, so the core product runs entirely on the user's own machine. The docs cover the official binary install, and a hands-on probe installed kitty 0.48.2 with the official installer and ran it fully locally, including the remote-control socket. missing for 10: evidence of open-source licensing or building from source, any documentation framing it as self-hostable or offline-capable.
